eligibility_evidence: Combating cybercrime is in the company’s DNA, shaping its technological capabilities to defend businesses, citizens, and support law enforcement operations.
YOUR MISSION Deploy and configure Group-IB XDR and Group-IB BEP for enterprise customers (on-premises and hybrid environments).
Support pilots and production rollouts, including remote and on-site assistance.

Choose your own path: deepen your craft as a technical expert, step into leadership, move across to another team, or relocate to one of our Digital Crime Resistance Centers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East & Africa, Central Asia, and the Asia-Pacific.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: About The Role This role combines deep technical expertise with real impact on customers’ cybersecurity resilience. This position is ideal for those who enjoy hands-on work with modern cybersecurity stacks, servers, network infrastructure, and virtualization platforms, while continuously collaborating with R&D, Product, and Threat Intelligence teams. What We Are Looking For Strong hands-on experience with Linux (Arch/Ubuntu) and Windows Server administration. Proficiency with diagnostic tools (tcpdump, Wireshark, curl, openssl) and log analysis (journalctl, Event Viewer). Native-level proficiency in Arabic (both written and spoken), with strong business and technical communication skills. Real challenges, real expertise.
